title: AllergenProfile
description: Probability that an entity carries each allergen unit. Bins: hard-coded for the demo by orders (kitchen/orders/bins.py, source manual). Tools, hands, plates: clean at shift start, then updated by the partner graph.

probabilities.description: Allergen unit ID -> probability. Units not listed are 0, unless unknown is true.

unknown.description: True when nothing says what the entity holds: a bin with no profile. Treated as possibly carrying every allergen. A tool, hand or plate starts clean (false) whatever its origin, unknown included: only an edge gives it risk (safety rule: known-clean source).

source.description: laya: read from a bin label (unused while bins are hard-coded). manual: set by a person. The rest are set by the partner graph.
